title: Three Houses Class Optimizer
description: Interactive Streamlit app that recommends class paths and builds teams for Fire Emblem: Three Houses. Scrapes game data, detects each character's natural role with cosine similarity against role archetypes, scores classes with eligibility and weapon-rank constraints, and simulates stat growth along the full path. Backed by a 200+ test suite and CI.

title: Steam Game Success Prediction
description: Predicts whether a Steam game will be well received using only information available at launch: genres, tags, feature specs, title, and release year. Review data defines the label but is kept out of the inputs to avoid leakage. TF-IDF and metadata pipelines with logistic regression and tuned tree ensembles reach about 0.80 ROC AUC on a held-out test set.

title: Amazon Review Sentiment as a Predictor of Economic Trends
description: Team project using a PySpark NLP pipeline on roughly 30 GB of Amazon reviews to test whether consumer sentiment expressed in product reviews can serve as an early indicator of U.S. GDP growth.

title: ASL Interpretation with Deep Learning
description: Deep learning pipeline for ASL video classification using CNN and CNN-LSTM architectures, processed with PySpark on about 10 GB of video data. Evaluates signer-independent generalization, bounding-box preprocessing, and top-k accuracy across controlled experimental splits.

title: Emissions Explorer
description: Interactive D3 visualization of quarterly greenhouse gas emissions (IMF data, 2010–2025) by region, industry, and gas type. Shows which sectors drove each region's emissions trend, including the 2020 pandemic dip and rebound.

title: Time-Series Modeling of Mental Health Indicators
description: Time-series analysis of CDC mental health survey data using Bayesian and Prophet models to forecast national anxiety and depression trends and quantify demographic disparities.

title: Modeling How Moisture Affects Wildfire Spread
description: MATLAB cellular automaton simulation modeling wildfire propagation under varying moisture and drying conditions. Explores ignition probability, moisture inhibition, and fire-induced drying dynamics.
